subject: S13 will touch ink OCR hook + ink_layers columns
body: S13 (notes/notebooks/ink_ocr) will: (1) add ink_layers.ocr_status/ocr_hash/ocr_at in migration 0015; (2) add a small hook in apps/api/naadi_api/ink/store.py (after a successful save, call a registered callback) to queue ink_ocr; (3) read apps/web/src/ink/persist useInkLayer('notebook_page', noteId) unchanged. Please say if you are editing ink/store.py or persist/* now, and whether notebook_page is already an accepted surface_type.
